audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua Ai ambush, king execution, Ebal altar, and public Torah-reading narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for renewed courage, plunder permission, ambush instructions, thirty-thousand/five-thousand figures, destruction of Ai, king hanging and burial, Mount Ebal altar, Torah inscription, Gerizim/Ebal assembly, and inclusive public reading.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Joshua, Do not fear and do not be shattered. Take with you all people of war, rise and go up to Ai. See, I have given into your hand king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid or discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. See, I have delivered into your hand the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אַל תִּירָ֣א וְאַל תֵּחָ֔ת קַ֣ח עִמְּךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל עַ֣ם הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְק֖וּם עֲלֵ֣ה הָעָ֑י רְאֵ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי בְיָדְךָ֗ אֶת מֶ֤לֶךְ הָעַי֙ וְאֶת עַמּ֔וֹ וְאֶת עִיר֖וֹ וְאֶת אַרְצֽוֹ

verses.restored: You shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king; only its spoil and livestock you may plunder for yourselves. Set for yourself an ambush for city from behind it.

familiar.text: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

modern.text: And you shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set up an ambush behind the city.”

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ לָעַ֜י וּלְמַלְכָּ֗הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֤יתָ לִֽירִיחוֹ֙ וּלְמַלְכָּ֔הּ רַק שְׁלָלָ֥הּ וּבְהֶמְתָּ֖הּ תָּבֹ֣זּוּ לָכֶ֑ם שִׂים לְךָ֥ אֹרֵ֛ב לָעִ֖יר מֵאַחֲרֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: Joshua rose and all people of war to go up to Ai; Joshua chose thirty thousand men, mighty ones of strength, and sent them by night.

familiar.text: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

modern.text: So Joshua and the whole army set out to attack Ai. Joshua chose 30,000 mighty men of valor and sent them out at night

original.text: וַיָּ֧קָם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וְכָל עַ֥ם הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה לַעֲל֣וֹת הָעָ֑י וַיִּבְחַ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֤לֶף אִישׁ֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַחַ֔יִל וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֖ם לָֽיְלָה

verses.restored: He commanded them, saying, See, you shall lie in ambush for city from behind city. Do not be very far from city, and all of you be ready.

familiar.text: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

modern.text: with these orders: “Pay attention. You are to lie in ambush behind the city, not too far from it. All of you must be ready.

original.text: וַיְצַ֨ו אֹתָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר רְ֠אוּ אַתֶּ֞ם אֹרְבִ֤ים לָעִיר֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י הָעִ֔יר אַל תַּרְחִ֥יקוּ מִן הָעִ֖יר מְאֹ֑ד וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם נְכֹנִֽים

verses.restored: I and all people who are with me will draw near to city. It shall be, when they come out to meet us as at first, that we will flee before them.

familiar.text: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

modern.text: Then I and all the troops with me will advance on the city. When they come out against us as they did the first time, we will flee from them.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֗י וְכָל הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֔י נִקְרַ֖ב אֶל הָעִ֑יר וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי יֵצְא֤וּ לִקְרָאתֵ֨נוּ֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֔ה וְנַ֖סְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: They will come out after us until we draw them away from city, for they will say, They are fleeing before us as at first; and we will flee before them.

familiar.text: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

modern.text: They will pursue us until we have drawn them away from the city, for they will say, ‘The Israelites are running away from us as they did before.’ So as we flee from them,

original.text: וְיָצְא֣וּ אַחֲרֵ֗ינוּ עַ֣ד הַתִּיקֵ֤נוּ אוֹתָם֙ מִן הָעִ֔יר כִּ֣י יֹֽאמְר֔וּ נָסִ֣ים לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְנַ֖סְנוּ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Then you shall rise from ambush and possess city, and YHWH your Divine will give it into your hand.

familiar.text: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

modern.text: you are to rise from the ambush and seize the city, for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

original.text: וְאַתֶּ֗ם תָּקֻ֨מוּ֙ מֵהָ֣אוֹרֵ֔ב וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֖ם אֶת הָעִ֑יר וּנְתָנָ֛הּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶֽם

verses.restored: It shall be, when you capture city, you shall set city on fire; according to word of YHWH you shall do. See, I have commanded you.

familiar.text: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

modern.text: And when you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do as the LORD has commanded! See, I have given you orders.”

original.text: וְהָיָ֞ה כְּתָפְשְׂכֶ֣ם אֶת הָעִ֗יר תַּצִּ֤יתוּ אֶת הָעִיר֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ רְא֖וּ צִוִּ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: Joshua sent them, and they went to place of ambush and dwelt between Bethel and Ai, west of Ai; and Joshua lodged that night in midst of people.

familiar.text: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

modern.text: So Joshua sent them out, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai. But Joshua spent that night among the people.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֣ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל הַמַּאְרָ֔ב וַיֵּשְׁב֗וּ בֵּ֧ין בֵּֽית אֵ֛ל וּבֵ֥ין הָעַ֖י מִיָּ֣ם לָעָ֑י וַיָּ֧לֶן יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הַה֖וּא בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעָֽם

verses.restored: Joshua rose early in morning and mustered people, and he and elders of Israel went up before people to Ai.

familiar.text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

modern.text: Joshua got up early the next morning and mobilized his men, and he and the elders of Israel marched before them up to Ai.

original.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֤ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּפְקֹ֖ד אֶת הָעָ֑ם וַיַּ֨עַל ה֜וּא וְזִקְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם הָעָֽי

verses.restored: All people of war who were with him went up and drew near and came before city and camped north of Ai, and valley was between him and Ai.

familiar.text: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.

modern.text: Then all the troops who were with him marched up and approached the city. They arrived in front of Ai and camped to the north of it, with the valley between them and the city.

original.text: וְכָל הָעָ֨ם הַמִּלְחָמָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֗וֹ עָלוּ֙ וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֔וּ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ נֶ֣גֶד הָעִ֑יר וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ מִצְּפ֣וֹן לָעַ֔י וְהַגַּ֖י בינו וּבֵין הָעָֽי

verses.restored: He took about five thousand men and set them as ambush between Bethel and Ai, west of city.

familiar.text: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

modern.text: Now Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set up an ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.

original.text: וַיִּקַּ֕ח כַּחֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיָּ֨שֶׂם אוֹתָ֜ם אֹרֵ֗ב בֵּ֧ין בֵּֽית אֵ֛ל וּבֵ֥ין הָעַ֖י מִיָּ֥ם לָעִֽיר

verses.restored: They set people, all camp that was north of city and its rear guard west of city; and Joshua went that night into midst of valley.

familiar.text: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

modern.text: So the forces were stationed with the main camp to the north of the city and the rear guard to the west of the city. And that night Joshua went into the valley.

original.text: וַיָּשִׂ֨ימוּ הָעָ֜ם אֶת כָּל הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֙ מִצְּפ֣וֹן לָעִ֔יר וְאֶת עֲקֵב֖וֹ מִיָּ֣ם לָעִ֑יר וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הַה֖וּא בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעֵֽמֶק

verses.restored: It was, when king of Ai saw, that men of city hurried and rose early and went out to meet Israel for battle, he and all his people, at appointed place before Arabah; but he did not know there was an ambush against him behind city.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.

modern.text: When the king of Ai saw the Israelites, he hurried out early in the morning with the men of the city to engage them in battle at an appointed place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set up against him behind the city.

original.text: וַיְהִ֞י כִּרְא֣וֹת מֶֽלֶךְ הָעַ֗י וַֽיְמַהֲר֡וּ וַיַּשְׁכִּ֡ימוּ וַיֵּצְא֣וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי הָעִ֣יר לִקְרַֽאת יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לַֽמִּלְחָמָ֞ה ה֧וּא וְכָל עַמּ֛וֹ לַמּוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽעֲרָבָ֑ה וְהוּא֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּֽי אֹרֵ֥ב ל֖וֹ מֵאַחֲרֵ֥י הָעִֽיר

verses.restored: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be struck before them and fled by way of wilderness.

familiar.text: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

modern.text: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be beaten back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.

original.text: וַיִּנָּֽגְע֛וּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּֽר

verses.restored: All people who were in city were called to pursue after them; they pursued Joshua and were drawn away from city.

familiar.text: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

modern.text: Then all the men of Ai were summoned to pursue them, and they followed Joshua and were drawn away from the city.

original.text: וַיִּזָּעֲק֗וּ כָּל הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בעיר לִרְדֹּ֖ף אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וַֽיִּרְדְּפוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַיִּנָּתְק֖וּ מִן הָעִֽיר

verses.restored: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel; they left city open and pursued Israel.

familiar.text: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

modern.text: Not a man was left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel, leaving the city wide open while they pursued Israel.

original.text: וְלֹֽא נִשְׁאַ֣ר אִ֗ישׁ בָּעַי֙ וּבֵ֣ית אֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יָצְא֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעַזְב֤וּ אֶת הָעִיר֙ פְּתוּחָ֔ה וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: YHWH said to Joshua, Stretch out javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for into your hand I will give it. Joshua stretched out javelin that was in his hand toward city.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Hold out your battle lance toward Ai, for into your hand I will deliver the city.” So Joshua held out his battle lance toward Ai,

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ נְ֠טֵה בַּכִּיד֤וֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּיָֽדְךָ֙ אֶל הָעַ֔י כִּ֥י בְיָדְךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה וַיֵּ֧ט יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ בַּכִּיד֥וֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּיָד֖וֹ אֶל הָעִֽיר

verses.restored: The ambush rose quickly from its place and ran when he stretched out his hand; they came to city and captured it and hurried and set city on fire.

familiar.text: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

modern.text: and as soon as he did so, the men in ambush rose quickly from their position. They rushed forward, entered the city, captured it, and immediately set it on fire.

original.text: וְהָאוֹרֵ֡ב קָם֩ מְהֵרָ֨ה מִמְּקוֹמ֤וֹ וַיָּר֨וּצוּ֙ כִּנְט֣וֹת יָד֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ הָעִ֖יר וַֽיִּלְכְּד֑וּהָ וַֽיְמַהֲר֔וּ וַיַּצִּ֥יתוּ אֶת הָעִ֖יר בָּאֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: Men of Ai turned behind them and saw, and look, smoke of city went up to heavens; there was no hand/place for them to flee this way or that, and people fleeing toward wilderness turned against pursuers.

familiar.text: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

modern.text: When the men of Ai turned and looked back, the smoke of the city was rising into the sky. They could not escape in any direction, and the troops who had fled to the wilderness now became the pursuers.

original.text: וַיִּפְנ֣וּ אַנְשֵׁי֩ הָעַ֨י אַחֲרֵיהֶ֜ם וַיִּרְא֗וּ וְהִנֵּ֨ה עָלָ֜ה עֲשַׁ֤ן הָעִיר֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יְמָה וְלֹא הָיָ֨ה בָהֶ֥ם יָדַ֛יִם לָנ֖וּס הֵ֣נָּה וָהֵ֑נָּה וְהָעָם֙ הַנָּ֣ס הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר נֶהְפַּ֖ךְ אֶל הָרוֹדֵֽף

verses.restored: Joshua and all Israel saw that ambush had captured city and smoke of city went up, and they turned and struck men of Ai.

familiar.text: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

modern.text: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the men in ambush had captured the city and that smoke was rising from it, they turned around and struck down the men of Ai.

original.text: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ וְכָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל רָא֗וּ כִּֽי לָכַ֤ד הָֽאֹרֵב֙ אֶת הָעִ֔יר וְכִ֥י עָלָ֖ה עֲשַׁ֣ן הָעִ֑יר וַיָּשֻׁ֕בוּ וַיַּכּ֖וּ אֶת אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָעָֽי

verses.restored: The others came out from city to meet them, and they were in midst of Israel, some from this side and some from that side; they struck them until no survivor or fugitive remained.

familiar.text: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

modern.text: Meanwhile, those in the ambush came out of the city against them, and the men of Ai were trapped between the Israelite forces on both sides. So Israel struck them down until no survivor or fugitive remained.

original.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה יָצְא֤וּ מִן הָעִיר֙ לִקְרָאתָ֔ם וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ אֵ֥לֶּה מִזֶּ֖ה וְאֵ֣לֶּה מִזֶּ֑ה וַיַּכּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם עַד בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר ל֖וֹ שָׂרִ֥יד וּפָלִֽיט

verses.restored: King of Ai they captured alive and brought him near to Joshua.

familiar.text: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

modern.text: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.

original.text: וְאֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ הָעַ֖י תָּ֣פְשׂוּ חָ֑י וַיַּקְרִ֥בוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֶל יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ

verses.restored: It was, when Israel finished killing all inhabitants of Ai in field, in wilderness where they pursued them, and all of them had fallen by edge of sword until they came to an end, that all Israel returned to Ai and struck it by edge of sword.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

modern.text: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai who had pursued them into the field and wilderness, and when every last one of them had fallen by the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and put it to the sword as well.

verses.restored: All who fell that day, from man to woman, were twelve thousand, all people of Ai.

familiar.text: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.

modern.text: A total of twelve thousand men and women fell that day—all the people of Ai.

familiar.text: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.

modern.text: He hung the king of Ai on a tree until evening, and at sunset Joshua commanded that they take down the body from the tree and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And over it they raised a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day. Joshua Renews the Covenant (Deuteronomy 27:1–10)

familiar.text: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

modern.text: All Israel, foreigners and citizens alike, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD facing the Levitical priests who carried it. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded earlier, to bless the people of Israel.

translation_notes: The chapter repeats Jericho's total-war pattern while permitting Israel to keep livestock and spoil, a change that follows the Achan crisis but does not make the conquest ethical.
Verses 3 and 12 give thirty-thousand and five-thousand ambush forces. These may describe separate detachments, compositional layers, or textual difficulties and require witness comparison.
Verse 17 includes Bethel in the Masoretic text, though narrative and textual questions remain about its role in the battle.
The ambush uses feigned retreat, an undefended city, fire, encirclement, and denial of escape. The text reports no survivor and twelve thousand dead, including women.
The king is hanged and then removed at sunset, continuing Deuteronomy's same-day burial limit even for an enemy ruler.
Ai's archaeological identification and occupation history are disputed; the narrative must not be presented as uncomplicated archaeological fact.
The Ebal altar and Torah inscription link conquest to Deuteronomy 27, but textual traditions differ regarding altar location, especially the Samaritan Pentateuch's Gerizim reading.

The closing public reading includes leaders, native-born residents, immigrants, women, and children. This inclusive access to Torah is a constructive thread that does not erase the preceding massacre.
safety_note: Never use Joshua 8 to justify ambush warfare against civilians, genocide, city burning, looting, execution, territorial conquest, or archaeological overclaiming. Keep Ai's dead visible while preserving the chapter's better closing movement: public Torah, shared assembly, peace offerings, and equal hearing for women, children, immigrants, leaders, and ordinary residents.
